description.narrative: Ordinarie utförd revision av det Sida-stödda SNV-projektet "Energy for Agriculture" 2016 uppvisade misstankar om oegentlig användning av medel avsedda för utbetalning av per diem till utbildningsdeltagare, varpå SNV tillsammans med ambassaden beslutade om genomförande av en forensic audit.

The audit for 2016 on the Sida supported SNV Project "Energy for Agriculture" revealed suspicion of misuse of funds aimed at payment of per diem for training participants. SNV together with the Embassy hence decided to carry out a forensic audit.

The forensic audit was commissioned due to an irregularity found in the statutory audit. The statutory audit had found that an officer had used part of the funds that were meant to be paid as allowance to farmers for transport and participation in trainings, for his own personal benefit. The forensic audit investigated all of SNVs ongoing projects to look deeper into this particular case of fraud and also see if there were similar cases in the operations. The forensic audit found one other case of the same kind of fraud and estimated the range of these cases. The two project staff members involved in the fraud were fired and left the organisation. After discussions with SNV and the Embassy the estimations of the forensic audit were of 37,466 SEK. SNV repaid these. Sessions on code of conduct and the new stricter procedures of management of funds in the organisation have been held with all staff. Sida HQ was alerted from the start and part of the communication.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
